techStack: Vitest ^3.2.4 with globals:true — describe/it/test/expect/vi/beforeEach/afterEach available globally without imports
jsdom ^26.1.0 environment; vite.config.ts sets environment:'jsdom', setupFiles:'./tests/setup.ts'
tests/setup.ts: beforeEach stubs global fetch with happy-path (15 products, page:1, totalPages:1); afterEach calls vi.unstubAllGlobals()
TypeScript: jsx:react-jsx, moduleResolution:bundler, verbatimModuleSyntax:true, types:[vitest/globals, vite/client]
Import conventions: named { render, screen } from @testing-library/react; default userEvent from @testing-library/user-event; relative ../src/App for component
Test command: vitest run (one-shot, no watch); defined in package.json scripts.test
userEvent v14 requires userEvent.setup() + await user.* calls (legacy userEvent.type without setup is deprecated)
features:
App.tsx: data-testid='results-count' on

with text 'Showing {count} products (page {page} of {totalPages})'

App.tsx loading state: renders —
Loading…
(no role attribute; query via getByLabelText('loading') or getByText('Loading…'))

App.tsx error state: renders

{error}

— no product list or pagination present
FilterPanel: #search (label 'Search'), #category select (label 'Category', default option value 'All'), #inStockOnly checkbox (label 'In-stock only'), 'Clear filters' button (no id/testid)
Filtering is entirely client-side: useProductFilters only re-fetches on page change; filterProducts runs via useMemo over already-fetched products
clearFilters in useProductFilters calls setFilters(initialFilters) — resets search:'', category:'All', inStockOnly:false, sortBy:'default'; does NOT trigger a new fetch
Product names rendered as <h3 class='card-title'> inside ProductCard; use getAllByRole('heading', {level:3}) to get all in DOM order

All 15 products: 5 Electronics, 5 Fitness, 5 Accessories; 4 out-of-stock (USB-C Hub, Noise-Cancelling Headphones, Dumbbell Set, Desk Lamp); cheapest: Jump Rope $15; most expensive: Noise-Cancelling Headphones $149; highest rated: Yoga Mat 4.8, second: Mechanical Keyboard 4.7; fixture insertion order starts with Wireless Mouse
architecture: 6 test stub files in tests/ each have a non-empty describe block and pre-existing imports but zero it/test blocks
Existing imports per stub: app.render → {render,screen}+App; filtering/sorting/clearFilters/pagination → {render,screen}+userEvent+App; loadingError → {render,screen}+App (no userEvent)
setup.ts resets fetch mock automatically — individual tests do not need to re-stub for the happy path; use vi.mocked(fetch).mockResolvedValueOnce/mockRejectedValueOnce only for non-happy-path cases
Test pattern: render(<App />), await screen.findByTestId('results-count') for initial async load, then synchronous getBy* for client-side filter assertions
After userEvent interactions that change filters (client-side), getBy* is safe — no extra findBy or waitFor needed because filterProducts re-runs synchronously

loadingError tests must call vi.mocked(fetch).mockImplementationOnce/mockRejectedValueOnce BEFORE render, because setup.ts beforeEach sets the happy-path stub and these tests override it for that one call
edgeCases: Spinner has no ARIA role; correct query is screen.getByLabelText('loading') or screen.getByText('Loading…') — getByRole('status') and getByRole('progressbar') will NOT match
Error is set in .catch() asynchronously — use await screen.findByRole('alert') not synchronous getByRole after render
Pagination: Prev disabled when page<=1; Next disabled when page>=totalPages; initial mock returns totalPages:1 so both are disabled simultaneously
getAllByRole('heading', {level:3}) to get product names — avoids h1 (page title) and h2 (Filters heading) appearing in FilterPanel
Combined filter (Electronics + inStockOnly): must assert 3 products present AND 2 absent (USB-C Hub, Noise-Cancelling Headphones) via queryByText returning null
clearFilters after await user.click() causes synchronous re-render — getByTestId('results-count') is sufficient, no findByTestId needed
loadingError 'never resolves' case: queryByTestId('results-count') must return null (not just spinner present); error case: queryByText('Loading…') must return null (spinner gone)
Search is case-insensitive substring match — 'keyboard' in lowercase suffices per requirements, no need to test 'KEYBOARD' separately
Default sort preserves fixture order (Wireless Mouse first) — not alphabetical; validated by getAllByRole('heading',{level:3})[0].textContent

tasks.description: Fill in tests/loadingError.test.tsx: add two it blocks.
